description: Return iLang runtime lite: the two syntaxes, the verb table (88 verbs with their 13 Greek aliases), the 29 modifiers, the error codes, the declaration body forms, the registry of 32 declarations and the entity registry (25 entities), taken word for word from the canon's full runtime and checked against its sha256. About 18,000 characters, where ilang_runtime returns about 93,000. Enough to write iLang and check it with ilang_validate; it leaves out the execution and judgment layers, so load ilang_runtime when a task needs them.
name: ilang_runtime_lite
title: Load iLang (syntax and vocabulary)
